description: CANA-TRACE : Tracé précis au 25 000ème des canalisations de transport de matières dangereuses du Grand-Sud-Est is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by admincarto.datara.gouv.fr. Chemical, oil or gaseous transport works in the Rhône-Alpes region, likely in the event of loss of containment to generate direct risks to people and property. A pipeline is a set of sections with a simultaneous uniqueness of product transported, condition, owner. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "CANA-TRACE: Precise route to 25 000th of the transport pipelines for dangerous goods in the Grand-South-East" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RHONE ALPES. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
